title: finding(components): `action:bar` / `action:group` / `action:menu` members bypass SchemaRenderer, so neither their `properties` nor their `params` are template-evaluated — `${record.id}` reaches the handler raw with no diagnostic
body:
Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat (seat #1, session `session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`) from objectui#7867's hand-back (dev report `5817335569`, `open_questions`, recommendation B). This is the follow-up the seat named in its ACCEPT on objectui#7867. ⛔ Not graded and not routed.

## Fact

objectui#7867's ruling A made `params` values templates, 「evaluated where `properties` are」, which is `SchemaRenderer`'s `evaluatedSchema` memo (PR objectui#10282). Members of container action renderers never pass through that memo:

- `action:bar` resolves each member with `ComponentRegistry.get(componentType)` and renders it with a hand-built `schema`. It bypasses `SchemaRenderer`, so a member's `properties` AND `params` are not evaluated.
- `action:group` / `action:menu` build the `ActionDef` from `action.params` directly. Same effect.
- Measured on PR objectui#10282's branch: an `action:bar` member with `params.recordId: "${record.id}"` on a record page reached `navigate_edit` raw (`{"recordId":"${record.id}"}`). No diagnostic fired, because the bar node's `actions` array is not a scanned string.

## Why it is its own card

The ruling sites evaluation in 「the same memo」 and refuses a second evaluator. Routing members through `SchemaRenderer`, or through the same `paramsBag` walk where the containers compose the member schema, also changes member `properties` and visibility evaluation. That is a larger behaviour change than objectui#7867 weighed.

## ⛔ Not claimed

- ⛔ No route is chosen here.
- ⛔ How many authored bar/group/menu members carry a template today: NOT MEASURED. spec `ActionSchema` refuses an object `params`, so object-action metadata cannot author one (see the sibling seam card on `params`' declared shape).

## Dedupe words

`action:bar member template` · `registry-mounted action not evaluated` · `action group menu params raw` · `bar member properties not evaluated` · `SchemaRenderer bypass action container`
